correctness.rationale: The claimed process redraws the sign at Poisson rate alpha, so actual reversals have rate alpha/2 and correlation decay alpha. The pinned RESULT.md two-by-two Fourier resolvent is G=(s+alpha)/(s(s+alpha)+v^2 q^2) with s=Dq^2-i omega; an independent SymPy complex-division check reconstructed Im(G)/omega=[(alpha+Dq^2)^2+omega^2-v^2q^2]/([D^2q^4+alpha Dq^2+v^2q^2-omega^2]^2+(2Dq^2+alpha)^2omega^2). For moving probes omega=qV, the sign numerator is (alpha+Dq^2)^2-(v^2-V^2)q^2. AM-GM yields the exact cutoff V^2+4alpha D >= v^2; strict negativity at q=sqrt(alpha/D) on the other side, and solving the quadratic in |q| gives q_plus/minus and product alpha/D. Fourier power equals -mu rho0 V^2 times integral q^4 |U_q|^2 K dq/(2pi). A real nonnegative Schwartz Gaussian multiplied by 1+cos(q0 x) produces symmetric Fourier packets at q0 and the origin, with zero-mode contribution o(L) and strictly negative band contributions proportional to L, giving an honest fixed-L positive-power witness, not an inadmissible delta. At equality only isolated q can make K=0, so every nonzero real Schwartz U has negative coefficient when V is nonzero. Plancherel gives the exact L2 spectral supremum, though not necessarily an attained optimizer. Setting D=(v^2/4alpha)(1-eta), q=(2alpha/v)(1+sqrt(eta) z), and V=v sqrt(eta) y yields uniform finite-region leading term (16alpha^2/(9v^2)) eta^2 y^2(1-y^2-z^2); its maximum is 4alpha^2/(9v^2) eta^2 at z=0, y^2=1/2. This checks boundary V=0, normalization, and no claim at finite potential strength. Source verifier matrix inversion and quadrature were read; the independent algebraic check and full proof establish unrestricted quantifiers.
